note: Synthetic, representative tasks for the O-01 provider comparison. Expected facts are the ground truth a correct BRD must contain; each is matched when every keyword appears in one statement (case-insensitive).

tasks.requirement:
Title: Add repayment metadata
Business objective: Improve reconciliation accuracy.
Description: Every loan repayment must carry the payment channel and an external reference.
Acceptance criteria: Channel and reference are visible on the repayment API.

Title: Customer address history
Business objective: Meet the audit requirement for address changes.
Description: Keep every previous customer address with the date it changed.
Acceptance criteria: The address history endpoint lists previous addresses newest first.

Title: Invoice PDF export
Business objective: Clients download invoices without contacting support.
Description: Provide a PDF of each invoice.
Acceptance criteria: The invoice page offers a PDF download.
